name: HideDroid
tagline: Hide personal details from the apps on your phone
description:
HideDroid lets you control how much of your personal data each app on your phone can actually see. You choose a privacy level per app, and HideDroid anonymizes the information that app collects, so nosy apps get less real information about you.

It's a way to keep using the apps you need while pushing back against how much they learn about you.
